pages.title: Trawler
pages.text: Set the trawler on the water surface and right-click it to cast or haul the net; it gathers fish and shrimp for you.$(br2)Each haul takes $(thing)60 seconds$() by default, and it has $(thing)19 slots$(): the top slot in the interface holds bait, the rest collect the catch.$(br2)Right-click to cast or haul — casting takes 2 seconds, hauling 3 — and $(thing)it only counts time while the net is down$().

pages.title: How to Place It
pages.text: The block $(thing)directly below the trawler must be a still water source block$().$(br2)If you cast it while standing on the bank and aiming at the water, it mounts itself on top of the source block; if water flows in from the side, the trawler $(thing)falls straight off$() — so keep it away from waterfalls and streams.$(br2)When the output slots are full it pauses, so come back regularly.

pages.title: Bait
pages.text: Bait can go in the bait slot, and each kind has its own $(thing)haul interval and consumption chance$():$(br)$(li)Seeds (c:seeds): 10 seconds, 60%% chance to be consumed$(li)Fruit (c:foods/fruits): 5 seconds, 30%% chance to be consumed$(li)Ancient Debris: 50 seconds, 2%% chance to be consumed$(li)Amethyst Shard: 500 seconds, always consumed$(br2)With no bait it falls back to the default 60 seconds.

pages.title: What the Bait Brings
pages.text: $(li)Seeds and fruit: haul in all sorts of fish and shrimp$(li)Ancient Debris and Amethyst Shards: use the $(thing)treasure table$(), which can bring up rare finds$(br2)The catch: $(thing)bait only works in open water$() — drop anything into a dead pond and you only get junk.

pages.title: Open Water
pages.text: The $(thing)5×5×3$() area below the trawler must be all water, and the $(thing)sky light$() above it must be at least 12.$(br2)When that holds, even without bait there is roughly a $(thing)89%%$() chance to roll the vanilla fish table and $(thing)11%%$() to bring up junk; when it does not hold you $(thing)only get junk$().$(br2)So moor it in the middle of a large lake or the sea, not in a one-block-wide channel.
